timeline.message:
Fix testShrinkAfterRollover

This fixes the flakiness in testShrinkAfterRollover which was introduce by the
restrictive `allocate` action in the `cold` phase. This changes the full policy
we use in the ILM ITs to use an `allocate` action in the `cold` phase that includes
all nodes.

This commmit also improves the logging in TimeSeriesDataStreamsIT and other ILM actions
ITs.
timeline.author: Andrei Dan

timeline.body:
This fixes the flakiness in testShrinkAfterRollover which was introduce by the
restrictive `allocate` action in the `cold` phase. This changes the full policy
we use in the ILM ITs to use an `allocate` action in the `cold` phase that includes
all nodes.

This commmit also improves the logging in TimeSeriesDataStreamsIT and other ILM actions
ITs.

Fixes #68395
this is where the fix for the test flakiness is (the rest of this PR is meant to aid with debugging test failures)
LGTM, thanks for working on these Andrei
